intended_use: Subtle repeating ground fill for the exterior area beyond store landscaping.
placement: Camera-relative screen-space tile drawn below exterior scenery and world geometry.

generation.reference: No source image; generated as a seamless ground tile
generation.prompt_summary: Top-down opaque seamless moss and olive grass tile with low clover, subtle groundcover variation, sparse tiny pale flowers and fallen leaves; no trees, structures, roads, objects, text, borders, or lighting gradient.

review: Inspected and captured in Godot 4.7.2 at 12x10, 16x12, and 20x16 plus a zoomed/panned 20x16 view. At 24% opacity it adds low clover, flower, and leaf variation without a pronounced tile boundary; motif repetition remains visible under close inspection. A 36% trial made repetition too strong and was rejected.
